arguments.where_clause: merchant_location_id IN (SELECT id FROM merchant_locations WHERE city = 'Rome' AND state = 'Italy')
arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction whose merchant location is in Rome, Italy. The rule has no date limit, so you can split the flagged transactions by month when you review them.
assumptions: Rome, Italy is matched as city = 'Rome' and state = 'Italy', using the exact stored spelling and case; other spellings of Rome would not be matched.
The rule covers all dates in the data (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31), so month-by-month checking is done on the flagged results, not in the rule itself.
Location is taken from transactions.merchant_location_id, not from the merchant's id.
